en.topic_title: In Pictures: Hong Kong pays final respects to former city leader Tung Chee-hwa
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong officials and the public commemorated the city’s first post-colonial leader, Tung Chee-hwa, at his funeral on Sunday, AFP journalists saw.



A public memorial and funeral ceremony for Hong Kong’s first post-colonial leader Tung Chee-hwa took place on Sunday, September 20, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Tung, who died this month at the age of 89, was a former shipping tycoon hand-picked by Beijing to run Hong Kong after the former British colony’s handover to Chinese
